candidate.title: SWE-TRACE: Optimizing Long-Horizon SWE Agents Through Rubric Process Reward Models and Heuristic Test-Time Scaling
candidate.abstract: Resolving real-world software engineering (SWE) issues with autonomous agents requires complex, long-horizon reasoning. Current pipelines are bottlenecked by unoptimized demonstration data, sparse execution rewards, and computationally prohibitive inference scaling, which collectively exacerbate token bloat, reward hacking, and policy degradation. We present SWE-TRACE (Trajectory Reduction and Agentic Criteria Evaluation), a unified framework optimizing the SWE agent lifecycle across data curation, reinforcement learning (RL), and test-time inference. First, we introduce an LLM multi-task cascading method, utilizing stepwise oracle verification to distill a 60K-instance Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) corpus strictly biased toward token-efficient, shortest-path trajectories. Second, to overcome the instability of sparse outcome rewards, we design a MemoryAugmented Agentic RL pipeline featuring a Rubric-Based Process Reward Model (PRM). An auxiliary Rubric-Agent provides dense, fine-grained heuristic feedback on intermediate steps, guiding the model through long-horizon tasks. Finally, we bridge training and inference by repurposing the PRM for heuristic-guided Test-Time Scaling (TTS). By dynamically evaluating and pruning action candidates at each step, SWE-TRACE achieves superior search efficiency without the latency overhead of standard parallel sampling. Extensive experiments on standard SWE benchmarks demonstrate that SWE-TRACE significantly advances the state-of-the-art, maximizing resolution rates while drastically reducing both token consumption and inference latency.
candidate.authors: Hao Han, Jin Xie, Xuehao Ma, Weiquan Zhu, Ziyao Zhang, ZhiLiang Long, Hongkai Chen, Qingwen Ye

panel.reason: SWE智能体长程RL与评分过程奖励，契合智能体训练范式
SWE智能体长程RL与过程奖励框架，代码任务闭环有代表性。

extraction.method: SWE-TRACE：评分标准PRM+启发式测试时扩展统一框架
extraction.data: 77仓库合成issue，140K候选筛为60K SFT语料
extraction.scenario: 长程SWE智能体训练与推理
extraction.results: 显著提升SOTA解决率，同时大幅降低token消耗与推理延迟
extraction.limitations: 未在摘要中明确说明；依赖oracle验证器与评分代理
extraction.summary: 针对SWE智能体面临演示数据低效、执行奖励稀疏、推理扩展昂贵导致token膨胀、奖励黑客与策略退化的问题，提出SWE-TRACE统一框架。该框架先用LLM多任务级联与步级oracle验证，从77个仓库的140K候选实例中蒸馏出60K偏向token高效最短路径的SFT语料；再用带评分标准过程奖励模型（PRM）的记忆增强智能体RL提供稠密中间反馈；最后复用PRM做启发式测试时扩展，在每步动态评估并剪枝动作候选。在标准SWE基准上，SWE-TRACE显著提升解决率并大幅降低token消耗与推理延迟。
